company.name: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence

profile_text.body:
The German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence, known as DFKI, is a non-profit government research lab headquartered in Kaiserslautern, Germany. On its own site it describes itself as recognized by the international scientific community as a major "Center of Excellence" in AI, and says it has focused on human-centric AI for more than 30 years, combining scientific excellence and commercially-oriented value creation with social awareness.

The site also points to the latest issue of its magazine, which it says focuses on current research questions around the perception, understanding, and agency of AI systems, and carries an item dated Paris/Berlin, 18 June 2026 concerning work with a French national research institute for research in digital fields. The site text provided does not name specific AI products, and no litigation, regulatory filings, or other corporate facts are recorded for the organization.
